high_level_description: The image is a split-screen of the same person posing on a red carpet at what appears to be a movie premiere. The backdrop features the title "Spider-Man: No Way Home" prominently displayed in large, bold letters with a blue and red color scheme. Below the title, there is additional text that reads "Marvel" and "No Way Home," indicating the event is related to the Marvel Cinematic Universe film. The person is wearing a form-fitting, deep red dress with thin straps and cut-out details around the chest area. She has long, dark hair styled straight and falls over her shoulders.
